title: Secret Santa
description: *Secret Santa* is a **web tool** for drawing gift names in a group. The organiser adds the people, taps who each person must not give to, and shares **one link**. Each person opens it, picks their own name, and opens a present that shows only who they give to.

I set the design: the link carries the names, the exclusions and a **fresh seed for every draw**, never the result, and every phone works out the same result from those. A warning names the person twice before anything is shown, so the surprise rests on honesty, not on accounts.
It speaks **Catalan, Spanish and English**, chosen from the system language. The draw gives every valid result the same chance, and it is **covered by tests written before the code**.
imageAlt: Headline "One link. Everyone opens their own surprise." beside two phone screens: the create screen with a list of six people and their exclusions, and the reveal screen telling Anna she gives a present to Elena
